subject.title: refactor(agents): move implicit-main fallback into load-time roster injection

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this branch’s load-time roster injection and default-agent compatibility contract across runtime, plugin SDK, and persisted session/state migration boundaries?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes a cross-cutting compatibility contract rather than repairing one isolated defect, and the protected maintainer label prevents automated cleanup from deciding that product and upgrade boundary.

options.title: Approve the compatibility direction
options.body: Confirm load-time roster injection, the retained deprecated SDK alias, and Doctor-owned persistence as the intended upgrade contract after reviewing upgrade proof.

options.title: Narrow the change
options.body: Split or defer state/session/plugin-SDK portions if maintainers want the roster refactor without changing all ownership boundaries in one landing.

options.title: Pause for redesign
options.body: Keep the current behavior until maintainers choose a smaller named-agent and migration plan with clearer public compatibility guarantees.

recommendation.title: Approve the compatibility direction
recommendation.body: Confirm load-time roster injection, the retained deprecated SDK alias, and Doctor-owned persistence as the intended upgrade contract after reviewing upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR history identifies steipete as the author of the current roster-refactor direction and its compatibility follow-ups.
